data.narrative:
ANYbotics is a Series B robotics and manufacturing company that has raised $50M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a peer set of 3 same-sector, same-stage private companies (Generalist AI, Bedrock Robotics, and Dexterity) supplemented by a broader comp universe of 8 private robotics firms and 1 public comparator, providing triangulation across market conditions and company maturity levels.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, anchoring to the $50M total raised as a proxy baseline, applies a typical 1.9x multiplier for Series B-to-next-stage progression, implying a valuation of $95M. Peer-median analysis across the three same-stage robotics comparables yields a median valuation of $1.8B, with a range spanning $1.6B (Dexterity) to $2.0B (Generalist AI).

The wide dispersion between methods—$95M versus $1.8B—reflects tension between capital-deployment benchmarks and peer trading multiples. A triangulated range of $81M (low) to $2.0B (high) encompasses both approaches, with a median of $922M. Key uncertainties include revenue traction relative to peer cohort, unit economics of current product deployments, and whether the peer set adequately reflects ANYbotics' competitive positioning within the broader industrial robotics market. Resolution of these factors is material to narrowing the valuation band.
